import awkward as ak
import numpy as np
from pocket_coffea.analysis.processor import BaseProcessor

class DimuonProcessor(BaseProcessor):
    """Minimal dimuon analysis processor."""
    
    def process_cut_presel_obj(self, events):
        """Object preselection: build MuonGood collection."""
        muons = events.Muon
        muon_mask = (muons.pt > 15) & (np.abs(muons.eta) < 2.4)
        events["MuonGood"] = muons[muon_mask]
        return events
    
    def count_objects(self, events):
        """Object counting: store number of selected muons."""
        events["nMuonGood"] = ak.count(events.MuonGood.pt, axis=1)
        return events
